author: More Perfect Union
description:
The crypto industry already announced $200 million in spending on the 2026 midterms, and we aren't even through the primaries. That's almost as much as they spent on the 2024 elections, where they were nearly 50% of all corporate contributions. And that money is already paying off.

title: I Interviewed Sam Bankman-Fried. It Got Weird.
